pages.text: 1. $(l)Hang$(): right-click the stand with a bag (up to 3, shown on the hooks).$(br)2. $(l)Catheter$(): put it into the patient's arm (vein minigame).$(br)3. $(l)Hose$(): right-click the stand with an empty hand, then the patient.
The first non-empty bag drips; when it is empty the hose moves to the next.
The patient can walk within $(cfg)4$() blocks. Further — the catheter tears out, an arm wound.$(br2)Looking at the stand shows what hangs and how much is left.
Shift+right-click with an empty hand — take a bag off: an opened one keeps its ml (hang it back later), an empty one is trash. Panel: "Stop drip" (the rest goes back), "Remove catheter".
The stand drips through it; a syringe goes into its port without a minigame.

Norepinephrine or propofol in a filled syringe — right-click the stand: into a saline bag. The bag turns yellow (norepinephrine) or milky (propofol) and drips for $(cfg)20$() min, delivering the drug gradually.
